import re
import sys


def main():
    with open("дані/текст.txt", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        text = f.read()

    sentences = re.findall(r"[^.!?]*[.!?]", text)
    word_re = re.compile(r"[^\W\d_]+", re.UNICODE)

    items = []
    for k, s in enumerate(sentences, 1):
        words = word_re.findall(s)
        if words:
            items.append((k, words))

    best = sorted(items, key=lambda x: (-len(x[1]), x[0]))[:3]
    out = []
    for k, words in best:
        out.append(f"№{k} ({len(words)} слів): {' '.join(words[:3])}")
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")


main()
